mechanism: probabilistic [E_KLF12_HIGH].istate line SUBSTITUTED for baseline.cfg's plain E_KLF12_HIGH.istate = FALSE; on a free variable; no rule edited
not_a_claim: This is NOT a measured prior. klf12_state_findings.json records that these data yield no biologically interpretable KLF12-high boundary, and that the pre-registered decision branch is NOT uniquely determined: crossing the two defensible readings of M1(a) with the two of F3 reaches GO, CONDITIONAL_GO and NO_GO alike. What rules out a measured prior under every cell of that grid is specificity, not wording -- all three M1(a) readings, and M1(b), also pass on a population simulated with no latent state. The raw-UMI sensitivity agrees on counts alone: 65.5% of detected cells carry exactly one UMI and the median detected value is one molecule in every unit, so these data do not justify mapping KLF12 expression onto a measured E_KLF12_HIGH prior.
MaBoSS occupancy is not calibrated adhesion probability.
Same-dataset scRNA conditioning is not validation.
A moved occupancy is not evidence of KLF12 causality.
